title: Volvo FM-FH Series 5 Custom Built Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Wild Bar #52
description: Series5 FM-FH Volvo FUPS compliant Wild Bar style Bullbar suitable for radar attachments. 75mm hi-tensile 6mm wall tube with heavy duty uprights, contoured to compliment the new cab shape. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate, same tensile strength as steel. Additional upright for added protection. Combination Indicator, Daylight Running, Park Lights recessed mounted in main uprights. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements.
